day 62: cast shadows from the glow (sh_glaze2 raw umber/ultra/black/rose, medium .85, body filbert 8, blend) -> cross shadows read as LOGS/BONES (reddish, thick, rounded ends), zombie leg shadows read as stilts. Also physically wrong: after sunset there are no hard cast shadows. Lift: knife scrape barely touched the thin glaze (scratch); dry rag lifts little; rag width 16-20 dipped 1.0, pressure 1, 3 passes refolding: interior lifts, leaves an OUTLINE ghost of the shape (rim of pushed paint). Must overpaint the outlines with ground color once set. Lesson: don't cast shadows in diffuse twilight; for glaze shapes, test on scratch at the real scale first.
Zombie: shirt darkened to zb_shirt2 (good). Flash-lit orange edges on zombie front + pale gold backlit rim -> figure reads 3D-ish. Gore streaks repainted with sk_match (mix apricot .75/gold .25) at y~300 -> nearly invisible; good.

local function dir(bx, by) local dx, dy = bx - S[1], by - S[2] local n = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) return dx/n, dy/n end
local r = rag{width=16}
local function lift(pts, passes)
  for p = 1, passes do
    r:refold() r:dip(1.0)
    r:wipe(pts, {pressure=1.0})
  end
end
for i, c in ipairs(crosses_def) do
  local bx, by, h = c[1], c[2], c[3]
  local ux, uy = dir(bx, by)
  local L = 1.3 * h * (0.6 + 0.4*smoothstep(500, 620, by))
  local s0 = 6
  lift({{bx + ux*s0, by + uy*s0}, {bx + ux*(L+6), by + uy*(L+6)}}, 3)
  local cx, cy = bx + ux*L*0.74, by + uy*L*0.74
  local bl = h*0.27
  lift({{cx - bl - 6, cy + 1}, {cx + bl + 6, cy - 1}}, 3)
end
-- zombie leg shadows
lift({{760,630},{760,714}}, 3)
local ux, uy = dir(850, 615)
lift({{851 + ux*8, 614 + uy*8}, {851 + ux*135, 614 + uy*135}}, 3)
print(r)

ld_hz2 = pile{{"lead white", 1}, {"raw umber", 0.6}, {"rose madder", 0.3}, {"ultramarine blue", 0.25}, {"orange chrome", 0.12}, {"Naples yellow", 0.25}}
ld_mid2 = pile{{"raw umber", 1}, {"rose madder", 0.25}, {"ultramarine blue", 0.4}, {"lead white", 0.4}, {"burnt sienna", 0.2}}
ld_near2 = pile{{"raw umber", 1}, {"bone black", 0.4}, {"ultramarine blue", 0.5}, {"burnt sienna", 0.35}, {"rose madder", 0.1}}
land = below({{0,478},{1000,474}})
work(land, {hand="body", tool={kind="flat", width=12, stiffness=0.6},
  piles={{ld_hz2, function(x,y) return 1 - smoothstep(482, 530, y) end},
         {ld_mid2, function(x,y) local t = smoothstep(482, 530, y) return t * (1 - smoothstep(570, 650, y)) end},
         {ld_near2, function(x,y) return smoothstep(570, 650, y) end}},
  angle=0, length={25, 80}, scale_at=function(x,y) return 0.4 + 1.0*smoothstep(476, 714, y) end,
  coverage=1.7, fill=true, clip=land, seed=1})
wait(10*24*60)
sh_glaze = pile{{"ultramarine blue", 1}, {"raw umber", 0.8}, {"bone black", 0.25}, {"rose madder", 0.25}, medium=0.75, name="sh_glaze"}
-- shadow A: soft band, glaze + fill + blend
local A = poly({{300,540},{316,540},{250,714},{170,714}}, true):soften(4)
work(A, {hand="glaze", pile=sh_glaze, coverage=2, fill=true, clip=A:grow(3), angle=-1.2, seed=2})
blend(A:grow(4), {angle=-1.2})
-- shadow B: same with body hand, filbert (more controlled)
local B = poly({{600,540},{616,540},{700,714},{620,714}}, true):soften(4)
work(B, {hand="body", tool={kind="filbert", width=10, stiffness=0.35}, pile=sh_glaze, coverage=2, fill=true, clip=B:grow(3), angle=1.15, seed=3})
blend(B:grow(4), {angle=1.15})

sh_glaze2 = pile{{"raw umber", 1}, {"ultramarine blue", 0.35}, {"bone black", 0.2}, {"rose madder", 0.1}, medium=0.85, name="sh_glaze2"}
local A = poly({{400,540},{412,540},{360,714},{290,714}}, true):soften(10)
work(A, {hand="body", tool={kind="filbert", width=12, stiffness=0.35}, pile=sh_glaze2, coverage=1.5, fill=true, angle=-1.28, edge="soft", seed=4})
blend(A:grow(8), {angle=-1.28})
sh_glaze3 = pile{{"raw umber", 1}, {"ultramarine blue", 0.35}, {"bone black", 0.2}, {"rose madder", 0.1}, medium=0.75, name="sh_glaze3"}
local B = poly({{480,540},{492,540},{460,714},{390,714}}, true):soften(10)
work(B, {hand="glaze", pile=sh_glaze3, coverage=1.5, fill=true, angle=-1.38, edge="soft", seed=5})
blend(B:grow(8), {angle=-1.38})

sh_glaze2 = pile{{"raw umber", 1}, {"ultramarine blue", 0.35}, {"bone black", 0.2}, {"rose madder", 0.1}, medium=0.85, name="sh_glaze2"}
S = {760, 478}
local function dir(bx, by) local dx, dy = bx - S[1], by - S[2] local n = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) return dx/n, dy/n end
local shadows = nil
local function add(m) shadows = shadows and (shadows + m) or m end
-- crosses
for i, c in ipairs(crosses_def) do
  local bx, by, h = c[1], c[2], c[3]
  local ux, uy = dir(bx, by)
  local L = 1.3 * h * (0.6 + 0.4*smoothstep(500, 620, by))
  local w = h * 0.075
  local ex, ey = bx + ux*L, by + uy*L
  add(ribbon({{bx, by}, {bx + ux*L*0.5, by + uy*L*0.5}, {ex, ey}}, {w*1.0, w*1.15, w*1.3}))
  local cx, cy = bx + ux*L*0.74, by + uy*L*0.74
  local bl = h*0.27
  add(ribbon({{cx - bl, cy + 1}, {cx + bl, cy - 1}}, {w*0.9, w*0.9}))
end
-- zombie legs
add(poly({{752,622},{770,622},{774,714},{742,714}}, true))
local ux, uy = dir(850, 615)
add(poly({{840,616},{862,612},{862 + ux*130 + 10, 612 + uy*130},{840 + ux*130 - 8, 616 + uy*130}}, true))
-- cowboy feet shadows going left
add(poly({{140,700},{200,700},{120,714},{40,714}}, true))
add(poly({{290,702},{346,700},{250,714},{180,714}}, true))
shadow_m = (shadows:soften(5) * land) - fig_all
work(shadow_m, {hand="body", tool={kind="filbert", width=8, stiffness=0.35}, pile=sh_glaze2, coverage=1.6, fill=true,
  angle=function(x,y) local a, b = dir(x, y + 0.001) return math.atan(b, a) end, edge="soft", clip=land - fig_all, seed=281})
blend(shadow_m:grow(5) - fig_all:grow(1), {angle=0.3})
